reasoning_content: Pushed! Now pull on VPS and rebuild.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

# Build server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm --filter @wasd/server build 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 8 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Output ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:500])

client.close()
EOF
